title: Mary Poppins blows in.
lines: In London, in a house with a blue door, live two children.
Their father works at the bank all day.
He never has time to play.
They run away from every nanny.
He throws it into the fireplace.
The pieces fly up the chimney and out.
The next day a strong east wind blows.
And there, in the sky, a woman floats down holding an umbrella.
She lands gently in front of the door.
She has a black hat, a carpet bag and an umbrella with a parrot's head.
Her bag has all sorts of things in it.
A lamp, a mirror, a plant.
How can all that fit in such a small bag?
The children stare with big eyes.
Mary Poppins says: Time to tidy the room.
In every job there's an element of fun, she says.
And then the job becomes a party.
A spoonful of sugar helps the medicine go down.
The toys fly into the cupboard by themselves.
Bert draws pictures on the pavement with chalk.
They jump into a drawing together.
Suddenly they're in a beautiful landscape.
And merry-go-round horses that really gallop.
They go to visit Uncle Albert.
When Uncle Albert laughs, he floats up to the ceiling.
They drink tea on the ceiling!
But Father thinks it's all nonsense.
He takes the children to the bank.
The children see how boring it is there.
He has a problem at work.
About how much he misses them.
He takes Jane and Michael to the park.
Together they fly the kite high in the sky.
Mary Poppins looks out of the window.
